name: semi-design
description: Semi Design System rules, lint hook, and /semi-init, /semi-audit, /semi-update, /semi-propose, /semi-triage skills for Next.js 16 + React 19 + Tailwind 4 web projects.
suggestedPrompts: Run /semi-init to set up the Semi Design System in this project
Run /semi-audit to analyze this codebase and plan a Semi UI refactor
Run /semi-update to upgrade @semi/ui to the latest release
Run /semi-propose to analyze project gaps and submit a feature request to Semi Design System
Run /semi-triage to evaluate and generalize incoming ecosystem issues
